result.reason: The clause does not reach the preferred position because renewal may occur by Customer’s unilateral election rather than mutual written agreement, and the automatic-renewal alternative lacks a 60-day Vendor reminder and a price-increase cap. It also fails the fallback because no 5% price-increase cap is included. Deleting the original 12-month renewal period and creating a Customer-only renewal right changes more than necessary; simply shortening the notice period would have addressed the stated comment. Although generally readable, the interaction between default expiration and Order Forms providing for automatic renewal is less clear than the original.
